extracted.intended_audience: researchers and research institutions seeking NRF funding; policy makers and stakeholders in South African research
extracted.subtask_description: Page outlining the National Research Foundation's statutory mandate, strategic goals, and organisational values that guide its funding, capacity development, infrastructure support, and public engagement activities. Useful for applicants and institutions to understand what the NRF aims to support and prioritise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research and human capacity development
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting, promoting and advancing research and human capacity development through funding and the provision of necessary research infrastructure, to facilitate the creation of knowledge, innovation and development in all fields of science and technology, including humanities, social sciences and indigenous knowledge.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a statutory object of the NRF (Section 3 of the NRF Act). Emphasis on funding, infrastructure provision, and inclusivity across disciplinary fields (including humanities, social sciences and indigenous knowledge).

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote development and maintenance of the national science system
rubrics_metrics.description: Promoting the development and maintenance of the national science system and support of Government priorities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NRF activity should align with building and sustaining the national science system and supporting governmental objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop, support and maintain national research facilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing, supporting and maintaining national research facilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NRF is responsible for ensuring availability and sustainability of national research infrastructure and facilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Science engagement (public awareness and engagement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting and promoting public awareness of, and engagement with, science.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NRF priorities include outreach and public engagement activities that raise science awareness and participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fund research, high-end human capacity and critical research infrastructure
rubrics_metrics.description: The NRF funds research, the development of high-end human capacity and critical research infrastructure to promote knowledge production across all disciplinary fields.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funding emphasis includes both research projects and investments in people (career development) and infrastructure that enable knowledge production across disciplines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create innovative funding instruments
rubrics_metrics.description: Create innovative funding instruments to advance the NRF's goals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NRF aims to design new and innovative mechanisms for distributing funding to meet strategic objectives and adapt to the needs of the research landscape.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advance research career development
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supporting researchers' career progression is an explicit goal; funding and programmes should contribute to human capacity growth and career trajectories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Increase public science engagement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beyond funding research, NRF seeks to broaden public interaction with science — proposals or activities that promote engagement align with this goal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish leading-edge research platforms
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish leading-edge research platforms that will transform the scientific landscape and inspire a representative research community to aspire to global competitiveness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NRF supports development of platforms and centres of excellence intended to raise research quality, transform the research ecosystem, and foster inclusive global competitiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inspire a representative research community and global competitiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Inspire a representative research community to aspire to global competitiveness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Equity/representation and international competitiveness are explicit aims; NRF activities should contribute to making the research community more representative and globally competitive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote South African research and innovation nationally and internationally
rubrics_metrics.description: The NRF promotes South African research and innovation interests across the country and internationally.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NRF supports activities that raise the national and international profile of South African research and foster international collaboration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Build bridges between research communities and partners
rubrics_metrics.description: Together with research institutions, business, industry and international partners the NRF builds bridges between research communities for mutual benefit that contributes to National Development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collaboration and partnerships (academic, industrial, international) that generate mutual benefit and contribute to national development are a strategic expectation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mandate derived from NRF Act (legal foundation)
rubrics_metrics.description: The NRF receives its mandate from the National Research Foundation Act (Act No 23 of 1998, as amended). According to Section 3 the object of the NRF is to contribute to national development by the listed functions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All NRF activities and priorities are grounded in statutory obligations; applicants and stakeholders should be aware of the legal mandate guiding decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Passion for Excellence (organisational value)
rubrics_metrics.description: Passion for Excellence — one of six NRF values that reflect and shape behaviours and organisational culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organisational decisions and conduct are expected to reflect a commitment to excellence.

rubrics_metrics.name: World Class Service (organisational value)
rubrics_metrics.description: World Class Service — an NRF value guiding behaviour and organisational culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NRF aims to deliver high-quality service in its operations and interactions with stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: People-centred (organisational value)
rubrics_metrics.description: People-centred — an NRF value reflecting prioritisation of people in organisational culture and behaviour.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs and practices should consider and prioritise people (researchers, staff, beneficiaries).

rubrics_metrics.name: Respect (organisational value)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interactions, assessments and governance should demonstrate respect for individuals and institutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrity & Ethics (organisational value)
rubrics_metrics.description: Integrity & Ethics — NRF expects integrity and ethical conduct to guide behaviour.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants and staff are expected to adhere to ethical standards and integrity in research and administration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accountability (organisational value)
rubrics_metrics.description: Accountability — NRF value guiding organisational behaviour and culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transparency and accountability in use of funds, reporting, and governance are expected.
